description: Built-in compliance check definitions for GitPulse. Edit this file to add, remove, or reconfigure built-in checks without changing Python code.

checks.name: Issue Assigned
checks.description: Did the student grab at least one issue to own? Everyone on the team should pick something they're personally responsible for.

checks.name: Branch + MR Created
checks.description: Did the student open an MR from their own feature branch? Work shouldn't be pushed straight to main.

params.label: Branch naming regex
params.help: Only enforced while the option above is on. Empty accepts any branch.

checks.name: Tests Written
checks.description: Does at least one of their MRs touch a test file? Code without tests isn't really finished.

params.label: Test file patterns
params.help: Comma-separated globs. Always enforced: an MR passes only when it touches a matching file.

checks.name: MR Linked to Issue
checks.description: Is the MR tied to the issue it solves? Either via the branch name (issue-NNN) or a 'Closes #NNN' in the description.

params.label: Require issue reference in branch or description

checks.name: MR Description
checks.description: Did they actually write what this MR does? A real description, not a one-liner like 'fix' or 'changes'.

params.label: Required template sections
params.help: Comma-separated headings. Only enforced while the option above is on.

checks.name: Code Review Received
checks.description: Did teammates actually review their MR before it was merged? You need fresh eyes on the code, not a solo merge.

checks.name: Code Review Given
checks.description: Did they review their teammates' MRs back? Code review is a two-way street - read and comment, not just request.

checks.name: Review Response
checks.description: When teammates left review comments, did they reply or fix them? Ignoring feedback breaks the review loop.

params.label: Pass when no review threads exist

checks.name: MR Approved
checks.description: Did the MR get at least one explicit approval before it was merged? (A merge itself counts as an implicit thumbs-up.)

params.label: Count merged MR as one implicit approval

checks.name: Merged by Author
checks.description: Did the author press merge themselves once approved? Owning your work end-to-end matters.

params.label: Allow author to merge own MR

checks.name: MR + Issue Closed
checks.description: Once merged, was the linked issue also closed? Tidy boards make happy reviewers.

params.label: Require both MR and issue to be closed

checks.name: Pipeline Green
checks.description: Did CI go green on this branch (with the test job actually running)? Merging red pipelines isn't shipping.

params.label: Require test job in passing pipeline

checks.name: Commit Quality
checks.description: Did they commit from a real Git workflow with proper messages - not mostly clicking around in the GitLab web editor?

params.label: Maximum allowed ratio of web-editor commits (0.0-1.0)
